subject: Permission to publish SOC 2 / ISO excerpt in joint Aurora case study
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Karen White <karen.white@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Permission to publish SOC 2 / ISO excerpt in joint Aurora case study

Hi Karen —

Hope you9re well. We9re finalizing the co-branded case study draft for Aurora and wanted to confirm one quick compliance item before we publish: we9d like to include a short, two-sentence excerpt that references Aurora9s SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations (we would not reproduce the full attestation).

Example blurb we9d like to include (draft):
“Aurora Health Systems maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations for its data handling practices; Redwood Inference operates as a verified service provider under Aurora9s compliance program.”

Attached are a one-page "Aurora_Attestation_Summary.pdf" (redacted for public sharing) and the current case-study draft (protected). Can you confirm whether Aurora is comfortable with the wording above, and if there are any required redactions (e.g., audit firm name, specific metrics)? If you9d prefer, we can provide an alternative wording that removes the auditor name and any sensitive phrasing.

If you9re okay with it, please reply with any edits or an approval note and we9ll move the draft to PR for scheduling. Our tentative publish window is Dec 22.

Thanks so much — appreciate the quick read.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn_hart@redwood.com
[t] +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: Aurora_Attestation_Summary.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: case-study-draft-Aurora-redacted.docx (document)]

From: Karen White <karen.white@aurorahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Permission to publish SOC 2 / ISO excerpt in joint Aurora case study

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks for sending this over. I ran the blurb and the one-page summary by our security and legal teams. Overall we're supportive of being quoted on the existence of SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations, but we have two small constraints:

- Please do not name our external audit firm in any public-facing copy; replace with "a third-party auditor".
- Remove any customer-specific operational metrics or uptime numbers from the excerpt.

If you send the exact sentence(s) you intend to publish with the auditor name removed, I can provide a quick sign-off. Otherwise, we9d like to review the final blurb before publishing.

Also note: our communications policy requires a short written consent PDF for our records. If you can route a DocuSign or attach a consent PDF, we9ll countersign.

Best,
Karen White
Director, Compliance & Vendor Risk
Aurora Health Systems
[karen.white@aurorahealth.com]
[Attachment referenced: none]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karen White <karen.white@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Permission to publish SOC 2 / ISO excerpt in joint Aurora case study

Karen 40 thanks for the fast review and helpful constraints. Per your note we've removed any audit firm references and scrubbed metrics. Below is the updated blurb we propose to publish; please confirm this exact wording is acceptable and we9ll prepare the DocuSign consent for your signature.

Proposed public blurb (final draft):
“Aurora Health Systems maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations for its data protection and handling practices; Redwood Inference is an approved service provider within Aurora9s compliance program.”

We9ve attached an updated case study draft (case-study-draft-Aurora-redacted.docx) with the blurb inserted and a single-page consent PDF ready to sign via DocuSign (link below).

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/aurora-consent/ABC123
GDrive draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-aurora-case-draft

If that text is good, reply here and we9ll send the DocuSign. If you want a tiny edit (e.g., mention "patient data" specifically), drop it in-line and we9ll update.

Thanks again,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: case-study-draft-Aurora-redacted.docx (document)]

From: Karen White <karen.white@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Permission to publish SOC 2 / ISO excerpt in joint Aurora case study

Marissa / Evelyn,

The proposed blurb looks good with one tiny tweak for clarity: include the phrase "for protection of patient data" so that it reads as follows:


“Aurora Health Systems maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations for protection of patient data and handling practices; Redwood Inference is an approved service provider within Aurora9s compliance program.”

We are comfortable with the auditor name removed and approve publication of that wording. I9ve also completed the DocuSign consent and attached the signed PDF for your records.

[Attachment: Aurora_consent_signed.pdf (pdf)]

Please confirm the final publish date/time so our comms team can coordinate.

Karen White
Director, Compliance & Vendor Risk
Aurora Health Systems
[karen.white@aurorahealth.com]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Permission to publish SOC 2 / ISO excerpt in joint Aurora case study

- Confirm publish time (EOD Dec 22 PST is fine) and notify legal at legal@redwood.com so we can clear press distribution.
